method: Every authored integer frame; BVH candidates on original sleeve and Chest garment triangles, then finite edge/triangle intersection. Shared seam vertex/edge contact under20micrometers is omitted explicitly. Original surfaces only, no audit caps. Rest-space distance from each crossing sleeve triangle to its nearest matching torso/sleeve boundary vertex localizes attachment contacts.
limitations: Finite sample frames do not prove interpolation or runtime blends.
Coplanar surface overlap is not comprehensively resolved by this noncoplanar segment test.
Triangle crossings at a joined garment can be localized cloth folding, requiring source-bound visual review.
runtime_override: Only the report output path was redirected; original diagnostic source and historical report are unchanged.
